{{Short description|Proof system for the Rust programming language}}

{{Notability|date=September 2026|reason=Requires more independent secondary sources to establish an article. I haven't looked in detail, but MS/Amazon sources are both likely not independent, as they share authors with the original Verus paper. It would be great to have more on FV for Rust here on Wikipedia, but probably too soon at the present moment as far as I can tell.}}

'''Verus''' is a [[formal verification]] tool for the [[Rust programming language]] that uses [[SMT solver]]s in its implementation.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Lattuada |first=Andrea |last2=Hance |first2=Travis |last3=Cho |first3=Chanhee |last4=Brun |first4=Matthias |last5=Subasinghe |first5=Isitha |last6=Zhou |first6=Yi |last7=Howell |first7=Jon |last8=Parno |first8=Bryan |last9=Hawblitzel |first9=Chris |date=2023-04-06 |title=Verus: Verifying Rust Programs using Linear Ghost Types |url=https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3586037 |journal=Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages |location=New York, NY, USA |publisher=Association for Computing Machinery |volume=7 |issue=OOPSLA1 |pages=85:286–85:315 |doi=10.1145/3586037}}</ref>

Verus has been used by [[Amazon Web Services]] and [[Microsoft]] for provably correct software development.<ref>{{Cite web | first=Bryan | last = Parno |date=2026-08-31 |title=Developing provably correct Rust code with Verus |url=https://www.amazon.science/blog/developing-provably-correct-rust-code-with-verus |access-date=2026-09-17 |website=Amazon Science |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Practical System Verification |url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/project/practical-system-verification/ |access-date=2026-09-17 |website=Microsoft Research |language=en-US}}</ref> The AutoVerus system uses [[Large language model|large language models]] to construct Verus proofs for Rust programs.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Yang |first=Chenyuan |last2=Li |first2=Xuheng |last3=Misu |first3=Md Rakib Hossain |last4=Yao |first4=Jianan |last5=Cui |first5=Weidong |last6=Gong |first6=Yeyun |last7=Hawblitzel |first7=Chris |last8=Lahiri |first8=Shuvendu |last9=Lorch |first9=Jacob R. |last10=Lu |first10=Shuai |last11=Yang |first11=Fan |last12=Zhou |first12=Ziqiao |last13=Lu |first13=Shan |date=2025-10-09 |title=AutoVerus: Automated Proof Generation for Rust Code |url=http://arxiv.org/abs/2409.13082 |journal=Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages |volume=9 |issue=OOPSLA2 |pages=3454–3482 |doi=10.1145/3763174 |issn=2475-1421}}</ref>
